decisions.subject: Pipeline for the 90-second Long Thanh explainer

options_considered.label: animated-explainer research-first explainer pipeline
options_considered.reason: Fits a data-grounded explainer with narration, custom visuals and music. The project already has a schema-valid research_brief with 13 data points and 18 sources.

options_considered.label: documentary-montage
options_considered.reason: Would fit source footage but no user-provided airport footage exists.
options_considered.rejected_because: No primary source footage is available.

options_considered.label: screen-demo
options_considered.reason: Not a software demonstration.

decisions.reason: The topic is a verified-data explainer with narration and generated motion graphics; the research artifact already exists.

options_considered.label: A. 40 km, and why that's the point (comparison)
options_considered.reason: Answers the title question with the distance contrast and verified capacity figures.

options_considered.label: B. Your flight moves in 3 waves, not one (timeline)
options_considered.reason: Practical audience question grounded in the official three-step transition timeline.
options_considered.rejected_because: Not selected by user; retain as a follow-up episode.

options_considered.label: C. 5,000 hectares of runway (data narrative)
options_considered.reason: A primary-document-led angle grounded in the 562/QD-BXD PDF.
options_considered.rejected_because: Not selected by user; retain as a follow-up episode.

decisions.subject: Render runtime for the explainer

options_considered.label: Remotion
options_considered.reason: Available; React composition supports custom maps/graphics and word-level caption integration, a strong fit for this 90-second Vietnamese explainer.

options_considered.label: HyperFrames
options_considered.reason: Available; HTML/GSAP gives strong kinetic typography.
options_considered.rejected_because: Word-level caption parity is not available in this pipeline phase.

options_considered.label: FFmpeg
options_considered.reason: Available for basic assembly.
options_considered.rejected_because: Not suitable as the primary runtime for custom animated maps and comparison graphics.

decisions.reason: The user approved Atelier + Remotion; captions and data-led custom motion fit the brief.

decisions.subject: Composition authoring mode

options_considered.label: Atelier: hand-author a project-local composition
options_considered.reason: A single hero explainer benefits from a bespoke visual language and scene compositions designed around this airport and its data.

options_considered.label: Templated: assemble stock cut types
options_considered.reason: Faster and less authoring effort.
options_considered.rejected_because: The user approved Atelier for a more distinctive final video.

decisions.reason: The user approved Atelier + Remotion. Stock creative components will not be reused.

options_considered.label: Data-driven explainer
options_considered.reason: The selected concept uses distance and airport-capacity comparisons.

options_considered.label: Teacher explainer
options_considered.reason: Could explain the subject accessibly.
options_considered.rejected_because: Less suited to the selected comparison-led narrative.

options_considered.label: Documentary montage
options_considered.reason: Would rely on real footage.

decisions.subject: Visual identity

options_considered.label: Custom infrastructure-documentary art direction
options_considered.reason: Asphalt navy base, runway amber for distance and emphasis, concrete off-white typography, verified-fact teal used only for evidence markers; IBM Plex Sans.

options_considered.label: Minimalist Diagram preset
options_considered.reason: Precise and technical.
options_considered.rejected_because: Its whiteboard look is less appropriate than a purpose-built infrastructure documentary language.

options_considered.label: Clean Professional preset
options_considered.reason: Restrained and legible.
options_considered.rejected_because: Reads too much like a corporate presentation.

options_considered.label: Flat Motion Graphics preset
options_considered.reason: Supports animated graphics.
options_considered.rejected_because: A generic flat look is less suited to the documentary direction.

decisions.reason: The visual system is designed specifically around runway geography, distance and capacity; atelier requires a fresh art direction.

decisions.subject: TTS provider for narration

options_considered.label: Vibi MiniMax Speech 2.8 HD, Vietnamese voice Haitrieu
options_considered.reason: Configured Vietnamese voice in the voice pool. Estimated cost about $0.14; supports Vietnamese narration and transcript alignment.

options_considered.label: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts
options_considered.reason: Available low-cost cloud fallback.
options_considered.rejected_because: The configured Vietnamese MiniMax voice better fits the selected language and was explicitly approved.

options_considered.label: Piper local TTS
options_considered.reason: Free and local.
options_considered.rejected_because: The configured default model is English; a Vietnamese Piper model has not been confirmed.

decisions.reason: The user approved Vibi MiniMax with a $0.20 ceiling. Credential is present in .env and loads through the registry dotenv initialization.

decisions.subject: Background music source

options_considered.label: Pixabay royalty-free music search
options_considered.reason: Available at zero cost; a restrained ambient documentary bed fits the voice and motion.

options_considered.label: User music library
options_considered.reason: Could preserve a preferred sound.

options_considered.label: Freesound
options_considered.reason: Free licensed sound catalog.

options_considered.label: AI music generation
options_considered.reason: Could tailor the bed to the composition.
options_considered.rejected_because: No music generation provider is available.

decisions.reason: It is the available zero-cost search source. Track selection will happen at the assets stage.

options_considered.label: YouTube landscape 16:9, 1920x1080
options_considered.reason: The user explicitly changed the requested format to landscape 16:9, which suits wide maps and side-by-side airport comparisons.

options_considered.label: Vertical 9:16, 1080x1920
options_considered.reason: Native to the Shorts feed.
options_considered.rejected_because: Superseded by the user's later explicit instruction: Landscape 16:9.

decisions.subject: Approved production spend ceiling

options_considered.label: Up to $0.20
options_considered.reason: The user approved this cap; estimated Vibi narration is ~$0.14 and Pixabay music plus local rendering are $0.00.

options_considered.label: Pipeline default $2.00
options_considered.reason: Would allow additional paid assets.
options_considered.rejected_because: The user approved the lower $0.20 ceiling.

decisions.reason: Estimated spend is ~$0.14, leaving approximately $0.06 headroom; no paid image generation is planned.

decisions.subject: Narration cut duration after measured TTS

options_considered.label: Keep Haitrieu at 1.10x and time visuals to measured narration (~73s)
options_considered.reason: Matches the generated sample and approved voice-pool speed; full narration measured at 69.89s and a closing hold plus transitions produce a 73.19s video.

options_considered.label: Slow narration to ~0.80x to fill the original 92s plan
options_considered.reason: Preserves nominal runtime but sounds markedly slower than the approved voice setting and exceeds the approved $0.20 cap.

options_considered.label: Expand narration to fill 92s
options_considered.reason: Requires new script and source review plus additional TTS spend; not necessary to tell the approved story.

decisions.reason: The user selected option 1: keep the approved 1.10x voice and accept a shorter cut. Timing was recalculated from ffprobe durations for all six generated section files; this runtime is 73.193s including brief inter-section breathing and a 1.6s closing hold.
